children: U.S. oil and gas producer's Q3 revenue rose yr/yr on higher oil and gas output
Company reported Q3 net loss of $2 mln, mainly due to derivative losses
Company raised quarterly dividend by 5% to $0.42 per share after quarter-end
Company guides Q4 2026 capital expenditures at $74-86 mln
NEW WELLS AND RETURNED PRODUCTION - Co said higher output was driven by new wells and return to production of New Mexico wells after prior disruptions
NATURAL GAS AND NGL PRICES - Co said improved realized prices for natural gas and NGLs contributed to revenue growth
LOWER OPERATING COSTS - Co said improved per-unit operating costs helped margins

The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas exploration and production peer group is "buy"

The stock recently traded at 5 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 5 three months ago
